notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Players,

We have some [b]important updates[/b] to share today: a brand-new equipment system with Gems, a new mode called Mass Madness, and a special coupon. Here’s what’s changing and how it works.
 [/p][h3]Gems[/h3][p][b]Gems[/b] are a new kind of [i][u]temporary upgradable equipment[/u][/i] that powers up as you play.[/p][list][*][p] Equip a gem and its [b]XP bar fills during gameplay[/b].[/p][/*][*][p] When the XP bar is full, the gem is [b]destroyed[/b] and you’ll be able to [b]see higher-level gems of the same category[/b] in the Gem Store.[/p][/*][*][p] The Gem Store [b]refreshes daily[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Mass Madness[/h3][p][b]Mass Madness[/b] is a new mode where your ejects [b]grant an additional +30% of the mass you eject[/b]. 
[/p][h3]Coupon[/h3][p]Use the coupon [b]TENYEARS[/b] in-game to receive a [b]big gift[/b] based on your [i]years of playing[/i]. 
[/p][h3]Stay Updated[/h3][p]For balance notes and future announcements, join our Discord: [/p][p][url="http://freakinware.com/discord"]http://freakinware.com/discord[/url]

See you in-game, [b]The Freakinware Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: New Season + Rewards + Update
notes.notes:
Dear Player,

The [b][i]new season[/i][/b] has begun, and excitement is in the air! Dive into thrilling competitions and showcase your skills until the season concludes on [b]November 1st[/b].

[h2]Season Rewards for Last Season[/h2]
We are thrilled to announce the winners of the Premium Battle Pass for the past season. Congratulations to all the top players!

[h3]Winners from Previous Season:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]1 VS 1[/b] – [i]scout[/i]
[*] [b]BATTLE ROYALE[/b] – [i]2Sauce[/i]
[*] [b]CRAZY MODE[/b] – [i]Rxnn[/i]
[*] [b]SPLIT PARTY[/b] – [i]Dreadful[/i]
[*] [b]TOURNAMENTS[/b] – [i]Power[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Rewarded Modes for Current Season[/h2]
Sharpen your strategies and compete for glory in the following game modes:

[list]
[*] [b]GUILD WARS TOURNAMENT[/b]
[*] [b]HUMAN VS ZOMBIE[/b]
[*] [b]2 VS 2[/b]
[*] [b]FFA[/b]
[*] [b]RANDOM TEAMS[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Other News[/h2]

[h3]Halloween Event[/h3]
Get ready for some spooky fun! The Halloween event kicks off on [b]October 14th[/b] and will last until [b]November 7th[/b]. Join us for exclusive Halloween-themed content, quests, and rewards. Don't miss out on the seasonal festivities!

[h3]Updates on Tournaments[/h3]
To ensure fair play and enhance the competitive experience, we've implemented the following measures for this season and the next:

[list]
[*] [b]Limited Access[/b]: Only the first two sessions that log into an account during the month will have access to the tournaments.
[*] [b]VPN Control[/b]: VPN usage is now monitored and controlled in tournaments.
[*] [b]Account Security[/b]: Sharing the [i]qw.sol[/i] file is a serious security risk and will result in an account ban!
[/list]
Please adhere to these guidelines to maintain a fair and enjoyable environment for all players.

[h3]Introducing Guild Wars Tournaments[/h3]
Starting today, Guild Wars have been transformed into [b]Guild Wars Tournaments[/b]! Each tournament is designed to test the skills and strategies of guilds, offering rewards for top performers—including exclusive items, guild points, and enhanced rankings. Rally your guildmates for intense battles as you climb the tournament ladder and aim to be crowned the ultimate champions!

[h2]Stay Updated![/h2]
To stay informed about all balance updates and other news, join our official Discord server:
[url=http://freakinware.com/discord]http://freakinware.com/discord[/url]

We look forward to seeing you in-game. Prepare for epic battles and unforgettable moments!

Happy gaming,
The Freakinware Team!

notes.title: MASSIVE GAME UPDATE + New Season + New Equips!
notes.notes:
Dear Player,

The [i][u]new season[/u][/i] is upon us, and the thrill is real! Engage in captivating endeavors and spirited competition until the journey reaches its peak on [b]November 1st[/b].

We've been hard at work to bring some exciting new changes and improvements to the game! Here’s a quick rundown of what’s new:
[list]
[*][b]Evolutions Replace Leveling[/b]: Leveling has now metamorphosed into Evolutions, opening up a new dimension of progress and power in your hands.
[*][b]Titles Over Nickname TAGs[/b]: "Nickname TAGs" have evolved to "Titles," offering a crisp and apt description of your accolades.
[*][b]Title Instead of Battle-Tag[/b]: We’ve simplified things; the Battle-Tag is removed and replaced solely with "Title."
[*][b]Item Level[/b]: Equipment will now display an "Item Level" to swiftly guide you in identifying superior items.
[*][b]Legendary Evolution[/b]: Introducing a new evolution tier – the Legendary Evolution, set to amplify your game with superior power and style.
[*][b]Battle Pass and Premium Version[/b]: Explore the new Battle Pass with monthly-resetting objectives and exclusive perks. Moreover, with the Premium Battle Pass, bask in additional rewards, free equipment, 3-letter usernames, and more, refreshed each month.
[/list]

That's not all!
Peek into the future:
[list]
[*][b]Equip Store Rework[/b]: A comprehensive equipment store rework is underway and will span several days, injecting fresh excitement into your gameplay.
[*][b]New Legendary Items[/b]: Legendary items have now landed across all categories for you to claim and conquer!
[*][b]Items Schedule[/b]: Beginning next week, expect a new legendary item to grace the game every Friday, progressively adding to the existing assortment.
[*][b]Beginner-Friendly Mode[/b]: Introducing a new game mode designed for newcomers, offering a fun and safe environment up to the Diamond evolution.
[/list]

And don't forget - our [b]Halloween[/b] 🎃 event is lurking just around the corner! Keep your eyes peeled for more spooky details soon.

Thank you for continuing this journey with us. Your passion and feedback have been instrumental in shaping these updates, and we're excited to venture into this new season together!
Whether battling or evolving, fun is the ultimate conquest!

Happy gaming,
The Freakinware Team!

notes.title: *UPDATE* Introducing Battlegrounds
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

In the today's update we have introduced Battlegrounds. Shortly, all the mini-games like "CTF, Soccer, Team Fortress, Territory War, Humans Vs Zombie" have been merged into one unique game mode called Battlegrounds.

When you enter a Battleground you will pick a random game mode between those.

Battlegrounds always have diamonds and there will be new set of quests and achievements relative to this mode.

Battlegrounds are on beta-test and could be removed soon.

** BUGS **

There are some problems that our technicians are about to solve, so please hold on!

** EQUIPMENT FIXES **

Previously the equipment attributes were screwed up for level 79 players, we have now fixed this and speed/other attributes should be fixed now.

** TERRITORY WAR **

We have shortened the duration of a Territory War battle.

** STRIKE.IS **

It's coming really soon, stay tuned!

Thank you all for playing,
Mitos.is Team!

notes.title: Evolution changes + Birthday Event + More!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,


We have recently changed the evolution system in order to make it more accessible by players.

Evolutions will no longer bring back players to level 50 and can be now obtained  at lower levels:

- Golden Evolution: level 29
- Ruby Evolution: level 49
- Sapphire Evolution: level 69

We have also lowered the prices for evolutions, check them now in the Evolution Store! (Home screen or Profile screen).

) Balance

- Speed potion now lasts 3 seconds (previously was 5).
- Gravity potion now lasts 5 seconds (previously was 8).

) Birthday Event

The Mitos.is birthday event will start on May 25 and end on June 5, it will reveal some great surprise, don't miss it!

) Laboratory

The laboratory is almost ready, it will allow players to craft new potions using potions as ingredients.

Let us know what do you think about these changes and, as always,
Have fun!

Freakinware Team
